record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/confirm.handler.ts:175 — Confirming a collective booking builds destinationCalendar from only the booking's single destination, so co-hosts' calendars never get events even though handleNewBooking now populates them

adjudication.rationale: In `confirm.handler.ts`, the `CalendarEvent` is built with `destinationCalendar` as either `[booking.destinationCalendar]` or `[user.destinationCalendar]` (a single-entry array) (diff around line ~175). Meanwhile `handleNewBooking.ts` now explicitly populates `evt.destinationCalendar` with additional co-host/team destination calendars for COLLECTIVE team event types (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). If confirmation is the point at which calendar events are created for bookings requiring confirmation, this mismatch means the confirmation flow will only ever create/update an event for the single stored booking/user destination calendar and will omit the extra co-host calendars that the new-booking flow would include.
